Uttarakhand Declares 'Hanuman Ashtak' Tax-Free After Box Office Success

The film 'Hanuman Ashtak' has been declared tax-free in Uttarakhand following its significant box office performance, exceeding ₹100 crore. Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami announced the decision, stating that the film's success and its connection to faith, particularly the Kainchi Dham ashram associated with Neem Karoli Baba, were factors in the decision. Dhami expressed his understanding of Neem Karoli Baba and the spiritual significance of Kainchi Dham.
